$description: Prism design tokens (W3C DTCG). One primitive: unit = 4px. Everything else is unit multiples or density-driven. No color tokens yet.

unit.$description: The only primitive. Emitted as 0.25rem so it scales with user font size.

density.$description: Unit-count multipliers that change per density mode. Select a mode with data-prism-density on any element; default also applies on :root.

pad-units.$description: Control block padding in units (each side).

pad-inline-units.$description: Control inline padding in units (each side).

control-sm-units.$description: Small control height in units (6/8/10 → 24/32/40px). Set directly so compact sm stays at the 24px WCAG 2.2 target size.

space.$description: Page and layout spacing. space-N = N × unit (N × 4px). Fixed across density modes.

radius.$description: Corner radius, odd-pixel ramp. radius-N = N px. Exempt from the 4px grid. Controls use radius-5.

border.$description: Border widths. Borders are drawn inside control heights (box-sizing: border-box).

leading.$description: Density-driven line height used for control text and to derive control heights.

control.$description: Interactive control sizing. md = leading.body + pad × 2; lg uses one more pad unit; sm is a per-mode unit count (6/8/10) so it never drops below 24px.

size.$description: Font sizes named by their px value at the default 16px root. font-size-N = N px.

line-height.$description: Line heights named by px value; every one is a multiple of 4px. line-height-N = N px.

text.$description: Semantic text roles. Each role = size + line-height + weight (+ family). Use these in components; use the numeric scales only when no role fits.

color.$description: Prism palette in OKLCH. One cool slate neutral ramp, a refraction spectrum (violet, blue, cyan, green, amber, red, magenta) and roles on top. Vivid steps sit in Display P3; each has an sRGB fallback (tokens.css, resolved JSON). Use the role names (color-bg, color-text, color-accent …), not the ramps.

0.$description: Hue 260 (not 0) so color-mix() in oklch never swings through red; chroma 0 = pure white.

slate.$description: Dark slate ramp (hue 260, low chroma). The only non-error ramp. 0 = white, 950 = near-black with a blue tint.

800.$description: Status text on the error surface (exact former error-status-text).

red.$description: Red (hue 27). Danger and errors. 50/100 tint, 600 solid and borders, 700 text, 300 text on dark. 800 is the dark text on the error box.

violet.$description: Violet (hue 288). Brand accent. 600 is the AA fill (white text), 700 is text on light, 500 is the vivid signature, 300 is text on dark.

cyan.$description: Cyan (hue 210). Spectrum only; no role uses it yet.

amber.$description: Amber (hue 80 to 52, warming as it darkens). Warning.

magenta.$description: Magenta (hue 338). Spectrum only; no role uses it yet.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text: descriptions, placeholders. AA on bg and surface.

border-strong.$description: Border that must be visible (hover, inputs needing 3:1).

border-popup.$description: Popup/listbox outline: a step darker than border (decorative, the elevation carries the edge).

accent.$description: Primary action fill: vivid violet. White text in light, ink text in dark.

accent-hover.$description: DEPRECATED for direct use: fallback for browsers without color-mix(); states now come from the shared state layer.

accent-active.$description: DEPRECATED for direct use: fallback for browsers without color-mix() (pressed).

accent-text.$description: Accent-coloured text and icons on the page. AA on bg, surface and accent-surface. Vivid: chroma near the Display P3 edge at this lightness, still 4.5:1 or more on its tint.

accent-surface.$description: Airy accent tint fill. Text on it: accent-text. Richer tint: L 0.915 with more chroma, inside Display P3.

surface-hover.$description: Fallback only (no color-mix): hovered item on bg. Prefer the state layer.

surface-pressed.$description: Fallback only (no color-mix): pressed item on bg. Also tracks and avatar fills. Prefer the state layer.

focus-ring.$description: Focus ring. At least 3:1 on bg and surface.

focus-halo.$description: Focus halo band: the focus ring at 12%.

track-shadow.$description: The faint edge shadow inside a progress track: the shadow neutral at 6% in light, 30% in dark (a dark edge needs more weight to show on a dark track).

lift.$description: White. Mixed into the start of a progress fill so the fill gets lighter toward its left end, in both themes.

shadow-urgent.$description: Base colour of the urgent (error) elevation.

on-solid.$description: Text on solid tone fills (neutral, info, success, warning, danger). White in light, ink in dark.

neutral-surface.$description: Neutral tone tint fill. Text on it: color-text.

info.$description: Info tone solid fill and icons.

info-text.$description: Info text on the page or on info-surface. Vivid: chroma near the Display P3 edge at this lightness, still 4.5:1 or more on its tint.

info-surface.$description: Info tone tint fill. Richer tint: L 0.915 with more chroma, inside Display P3.

success.$description: Success tone solid fill and icons.

success-text.$description: Success text on the page or on success-surface. Vivid: chroma near the Display P3 edge at this lightness, still 4.5:1 or more on its tint.

success-surface.$description: Success tone tint fill. Richer tint: L 0.915 with more chroma, inside Display P3.

warning.$description: Warning tone solid fill and icons.

warning-text.$description: Warning text on the page or on warning-surface. Vivid: chroma near the Display P3 edge at this lightness, still 4.5:1 or more on its tint.

warning-surface.$description: Warning tone tint fill. Richer tint: L 0.915 with more chroma, inside Display P3.

danger-text.$description: Danger text on the page or on danger-surface. Vivid: chroma near the Display P3 edge at this lightness, still 4.5:1 or more on its tint.

danger-surface.$description: Danger tone tint fill. Richer tint: L 0.915 with more chroma, inside Display P3.

error-text.$description: Error message text. AA on bg.

error-surface-base.$description: Opaque red behind color-error-surface. Lets opaque surfaces (destructive button) mix the exact error-box tint over color-bg. NAME PENDING.

state.$description: Shared state layer (NAME PENDING). Percent of a surface's on-colour mixed into its fill: color-mix(in oklch, var(--_bg), var(--_on) <state>). Implemented once in src/internal/state-layer.ts. Light overlays: hover 6%, selected 11%, selected+hover 15%, pressed 12%. Selected+pressed uses pressed.

selected.$description: Selected/current/checked/toggle pressed. Always paired with a non-colour indicator.

selected-hover.$description: A selected surface under the pointer.

focus.$description: Focus indicator that grows in: ring-offset gap (1px) in color-bg, a ring-width ring (2px, ring-blur edge) in color-focus-ring, then a halo-width halo (1px). Total reach = 4px, so label (space-1) and description (space-2) gaps stay normal.

ring-blur.$description: Slight softening of the ring edge.

halo-width.$description: Soft halo band visible past the ring's outer edge.

halo.$description: Alias of color-focus-halo (kept for existing references).

duration.$description: Motion durations. NAME PENDING (provisional). Zeroed (0.01ms) under prefers-reduced-motion by the theme.

default.$description: Focus-ring grow-in; settle time of ease.spring.

slow.$description: Popup slide-down; settle time of ease.spring-bouncy.

motion.$description: Component motion lengths. Zeroed under prefers-reduced-motion by the theme.

switch.$description: Switch: total time to turn on (off takes 85%, 340ms). Thumb slide on ease.overshoot; stretch 0-160ms on ease.standard, spring back 160-400ms on ease.recoil; track wash starts at 40ms on ease.settle.

ease.$description: Easing curves. NAME PENDING (provisional). Springs are generated by scripts/spring.mjs as CSS linear(); $value is the cubic-bezier fallback for engines without linear().

standard.$description: Default for colour, border and the error box (never springy).

spring.$description: Critically damped (ζ≈1), no overshoot. Pair with duration.default.

spring-bouncy.$description: Underdamped (ζ≈0.72), ~4% overshoot. Pair with duration.slow. Transforms only.

settle.$description: Smooth in and out, no overshoot. The switch's track wash.

overshoot.$description: Slight overshoot (about 4%) that settles. The switch thumb's slide.

recoil.$description: Stronger overshoot for a spring back into shape. The switch thumb's stretch recovery.

progress.$description: Progress bar. The fill is a gradient over its own filled width: the tone colour at the leading (right) edge, lifted toward white at the left end. Both ends must stay at least 3:1 on the track (test/tokens.test.mjs checks every tone, both themes, sRGB and P3).

fill-lift.$description: Share of color-lift mixed into the left end of the fill. Light is capped at 18% so the lightest end of the weakest tone (success) still holds 3:1 on the track; dark can lift further.

elevation.$description: Shared elevation foundation (NAME PENDING). Three semantic levels usable by any raised surface: popovers, menus, dialogs, field status. Built from color-shadow (slate-950) and color-shadow-urgent (red-600) via color-mix(); the build emits literal fallbacks for browsers without color-mix().

default.$value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow} 6%, transparent), 0 4px 12px -2px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow} 12%, transparent)
default.$description: Resting raised surface: open menu, popover.

hover.$value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow} 8%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -1px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow} 16%, transparent)
hover.$description: Interactive item on hover/press (lifts within a raised surface).

urgent.$value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow-urgent} 12%, transparent), 0 4px 12px -2px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow-urgent} 24%, transparent)
urgent.$description: Error-urgent: attached error/status box. Tinted from red-600.

track.$description: Progress track: a faint inset edge all the way round. Painted over the fill too, so the edge stays even where the bar is full.

gradient.$description: Prism light. Interpolated in oklch where supported; a plain linear-gradient elsewhere. Backgrounds only: never put text on spectrum or refract without checking contrast.

spectrum.$description: The full refraction spectrum, violet to magenta.

refract.$description: Brand sweep: violet through blue into cyan.

mist.$description: Airy wash of pale tints. Safe behind color-text (>= 4.5:1).
